costPolicy.materials: explicit LevelUpMaterials rows grouped by Level; preserve ItemType, ItemId, Count
costPolicy.skillLocator: regular gotSkillIds[targetLevel-1] or HeartFetter HeroHeartFetterSkills[targetLevel-1]; locator only, no effect reinterpretation

relationContract.regular: canonical heroId -> frozen Hero shard -> bonds[]; preserve explicit order/fetterId/cost fields only
relationContract.heart: canonical heroId -> frozen HeartFetter raw evidence heroHeartFetterId + heroHeartFetterSourceIndex -> ConfigDataHeroHeartFetterInfo[sourceIndex], requiring exact ID equality
relationContract.item: cost ItemType=6 + ItemId -> ConfigDataItemInfo.ID only when all matching source records agree on Name/Desc/Icon

legacyValidation.scope: Prior validation covers 267 Heroes, 1,335 regular Fetter refs, 267 Heart Fetter refs, and Item metadata conflict screening; this Target admission is limited to Hero 15 explicit raw rows and endpoint locators.

transformation.itemRelation: Preserve every LevelUpMaterials row in source array order. The legacy contract declares ItemType=6 + ItemId to ConfigDataItemInfo.ID; exact ID matches and item metadata were checked in the pinned ConfigDataItemInfo bytes. No item identity Canonical created.
transformation.goldLocator: Apply the pinned contract literal LevelUpGold[targetLevel-2] only for explicitly declared targetLevels 2..10; store the source array index, not a computed cost.

limitations: Admits source-native item endpoint references and level-to-array locators only. Item names/descriptions/icons are evidence for endpoint consistency, not target global Item Identity admission.
Does not admit item purpose/localization, actual item consumption, gold deduction, or reward/payment runtime rules.
No Fetter UI, Generated consumer, or publication approval.
